name: Coconut Cay RV Resort
note: Small resort of 25 pull-in sites on a mangrove spit beside the Marathon airport, with a pool and boat slips. Rates include a mandatory 10% resort fee. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site coconutcayrvresort.com read 2026-10-30: 25 pull-in sites with electric, water and sewer in three types (Pool, Preserve, Sunset), a park map (PDF, Aug 2023), phone 305-289-1870, and a Sirvoy booking engine on its Book Now page that sold one night for 2 guests in 1 motorhome (Rv Site/Poolside, Jan 12-13 2027, $159 + $15.90 resort fee + tax) with no application or minimum; satellite shows motorhomes and fifth wheels on the sites; Good Sam types it RV_PARK (not a condo park); Google Maps open, 4.7/162, phone matches -> real transient RV resort; price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator's park map shows one row of RV sites on the SW side of the park road, with the 'Preserve' mangroves behind them, a dredged channel with transient boat slips on the far (NE) side of the road, and a shared 'sunset beach' at the NW tip. Esri satellite (sat.py, rendered: 2.4 km frame at 24.7240,-81.0645 and 180 m / 140 m frames at 24.7240,-81.0650, 24.7233,-81.0633 and 24.72357,-81.06420) confirms it: the pads sit on open sand backed by a dense mangrove belt that screens the tidal lagoon to the SW. The water on the NE side is a canal about 17-20 m wide, not open bay, and the pads are separated from it by the paved park road and a continuous mangrove fringe. The open bay is reached only at the beach on the spit's tip, a shared amenity about 70-100 m beyond the westernmost sites, behind palms and mangroves. No RV pad sits on, or has a clear view of, open water. Default down.
fees_source: https://coconutcayrvresort.com/Book-Now.html (Sirvoy engine id b87786c076506f30), read 2026-10-30, 2 adults, 1 caravan/motorhome. Tue Jan 12-Wed Jan 13 2027: Rv Site/Poolside $159, Preserve $179, Sunset $199 per night. The same list rates were quoted for Mar 9, Jun 8, Sep 14 and Nov 9 2027. The booking details page adds a mandatory 'Resort Fee' of 10% a night ($15.90 on one night, $31.80 on two nights at $159), then Bed Tax and Sales Tax ($194.78 total for one night). nightly_low = $159 + $15.90; nightly_high = $199 + $19.90. Near-term nights were discounted: $89-$99 on Oct 30 and Nov 10 2026.
flags: Cheapest in-season night is $159 plus a mandatory 10% resort fee ($174.90 before tax) for a Poolside site. Preserve is $179 and Sunset $199 (+10%). The engine quoted the same list rates for Jan, Mar, Jun, Sep and Nov 2027, with short-notice discounts to $89-$99 in Oct-Nov 2026.

Online booking is real: the Sirvoy engine on the operator's Book Now page sells one night with no minimum, application or rig questions. On Jan 12 2027 it offered 6 of the RV sites (1 Poolside, 3 Preserve, 2 Sunset). It also rents a park-owned fifth wheel and houseboat 'Aqua Lodges'. Campendium and older listings mention weekly and monthly rates, but nothing suggests the park is mostly long-stay.

Dead-domain caveat: coconutcayrv.com, which RV Life, Firefly and Stay Sublime still link, has redirected to Indonesian gambling spam since about Jan 2024 (Wayback). The Firefly 'Coconut Cay Rv Park & Marina' and Stay Sublime Airstream pages are stale ('Online reservations disabled'). The live site is coconutcayrvresort.com, which Google Maps links.

Phones: 305-289-1870 on the operator site, Google, Good Sam and RV Life. The 2023 park map and the Stay Sublime page give 305-289-7672 (marina/property line). Reservations email: reservations@keyslodging.com.
No posted max rig length. Satellite shows Class A motorhomes and fifth wheels on the pull-in sites, so a 23-ft Class C fits.
Good Sam directory: RV_PARK, not a Good Sam Park (gs false), military discount true. Not a Sun, Thousand Trails or condo/owner-lot park.
RV Life: 4.5 stars from 18 reviews (last review May 2026), $$$$ tier, avg_rate $143. The candidate record had stars null. Sits next to the Marathon airport runway, so expect some aircraft noise.
